idea-plugin.name: Erbsland Configuration Language (ELCL)
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for the Erbsland Configuration Language.

Provides syntax highlighting, parsing, diagnostics, ELCL-VR authoring support, folding, structure view, commenting, completion, optional placeholder highlighting, and Core-compatible formatting for .elcl files.

Language reference · Source code · Issue tracker
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.6.2

  • Show matching, syntax-highlighted examples beside each group of settings, updating as options change.
  • Fix quoted text-name validation and next-line scalar values, including regex patterns and URLs.
  • Add optional Erbsland Core placeholder highlighting, enabled by default, with separate colors for source/filter names, parameters, and delimiters.
  • Add built-in Reformat Code support with all Core style options, configuration files, selector rules, and live settings previews.
  • Keep completion naming preferences independent of formatting settings.
  • Update the IntelliJ Platform and Grammar-Kit Gradle plugins to 2.20.0, retaining support for IDE version 2025.2 and newer.
  • Redesign settings with focused Layout, Names, Sections, Lists, and Completion tabs and padded controls.
  • Loading elcl_format.elcl and local includes (disabled by default).
